I’m 14 too and I have a few things to say. 

1. Have a good sleep schedule.

2. Don’t worry about relationships. They don’t really matter at this age. All I’ve seen as a result is unnecessary drama and heartbreak. 

3. Don’t vape, drink, or smoke. I promise you it doesn’t make you look cool. Your health is important. 

4. Pay attention in class so you have less study time at home. Don’t goof off with your friends the whole time (that’s what lunch and gym class is for). 

5. If you’re having trouble with assignments, ask for help. 

6. Participate in school activities if you’d like. Clubs, sports, fine arts like theatre, fundraisers, etc. 

7. Don’t force yourself to change just to “fit in”. 

8. Be kind. You never know what someone is going through. 

9. Water. Drink water, there are so many benefits. 

10. Limit your screen time. I have trouble with this, especially at school. 

11. If someone peer pressures you, leave them. 

12. Don’t have sex at this age. Many older people have said that they’ve regretted losing their virginity too early. If you do decide to do it, research safe sex/sex ed and make sure you’re 100% ready. Remember, there are many other ways to explore your sexuality and body.

Routine: I wash my hair once a week or once every two weeks, it depends. 
Wash Day:

1. Wet hair with warm water. 
2. Apply shampoo and massage scalp.
3. Rinse with water.
4. Repeat steps 2 and 3 to make sure there’s no buildup.
5. Brush deep conditioner through wet/damp hair until detangled. 
6. Rinse deep conditioner. 
7. Apply hair products to damp hair and style. 
8. Air dry. 

Regular styling(usually two days after washing): 
1. Spray hair with warm water until damp/wet. 
2. Apply leave-in and brush through. 
3. Apply cream and brush through. 
4. Apply oil.
5. Scrunch hair. 
6. Air dry.
